author: GameSpot
description:
We cover 32 simple and complex tips, tricks, and facts in Crimson Desert that aren’t quite as well known, such as impaling enemies in barricades, freezing the water out of mud, and possibly the first to uncover the full potential of Master Du's Circlet. The recently released Crimson Desert has a massive world with endless possibilities, and we're only starting to scratch the surface of all this game has to offer.
